fact_english: For sea turtles, the temperature of the sand decides whether the hatchlings become male or female; warmer sand gives more females.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Sa pawikan, ang init ng buhangin ang nagpapasya kung babae o lalaki ang mapipisa. Mas mainit, mas maraming babae!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Ang buhangin, may say sa gender reveal.

after_text: Nawala si Sinag sa isang ihip ng hangin na amoy sunog na asukal.
why_here: After Sinag vanishes in a breath of burnt-sugar wind, the confrontation on the ark roof is over, and the next line ("Pagkatapos, si Tubal.") opens a new scene in Tondo. Moved on 13 Nov from after sentence 25, where it split Tala's declaration and its reason at the peak of the standoff.
